# CANDIDATE: EMA_RIBBON_CONVERGENCE_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts to a narrow width (indicating low volatility/squeeze) and then expands with price closing beyond the outer EMA, it signals the start of a short-term momentum move. This setup captures volatility contraction followed by expansion with volume confirmation, distinct from Bollinger Band-based squeezes by using the EMA ribbon itself as both volatility filter and trigger.

## Mechanism

Entry: If ribbon width (EMA55-EMA8) < 0.3*ATR(14) for three consecutive bars (ribbon squeeze) AND the next bar closes > EMA55 (long) or < EMA8 (short) with volume > average volume of the last 20 bars, enter long/short at that bar’s close.  
Exit: Stop at the opposite edge of the ribbon (e.g., for long stop at EMA8); target at a fixed 1.5× ribbon width from entry or use a trailing chandelier exit based on ATR(14).  
Regime filter: Only active during 10:30-14:00 ET when VIX < 20 to avoid first/last 30 min chop and focus on mid-day trend development.
